modelReview.summary: The manuscript fails to report the primary result (partial correlation and p-value) in the Results section. Model diagnostics are missing. No confidence interval is provided. Critical reporting and review gaps prevent use as evidence.

findings.title: Primary analysis result absent from manuscript
findings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot assess the study's main finding without the partial correlation estimate and its uncertainty in the manuscript body.
findings.actionableFix: Add the partial correlation coefficient (0.654), p-value, and a confidence interval for the correlation to the Results section, with appropriate cautious interpretation.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that manuscript Results section contains numeric estimate and uncertainty from stats-run.json.

findings.title: No model diagnostics for partial correlation assumptions
findings.whyItMatters: Partial correlation assumes linearity, normality of residuals, and homoscedasticity. Violations can invalidate the estimate.
findings.actionableFix: Provide diagnostic plots (e.g., residual vs. fitted, Q-Q plot) and tests, or explicitly state that assumptions were checked and satisfied. Include these in supplementary or main text.

findings.title: Confidence interval for partial correlation missing
findings.whyItMatters: The point estimate alone gives no sense of precision; a 95% CI is essential for interpretability.
findings.actionableFix: Compute and report a 95% CI for the partial correlation (e.g., via Fisher transformation) alongside the p-value.

findings.title: Extremely small p-value may mislead readers
findings.whyItMatters: A p-value of 1e-30 could be misinterpreted as a measure of effect size or practical importance. Caution is needed.
findings.actionableFix: Add explicit statement that the p-value does not equate to effect size and that with large n small effects can be significant; emphasize the moderate correlation coefficient.

findings.title: Study not placed in context of existing research
findings.whyItMatters: Without references or comparison, the local evidence cannot be interpreted against known associations.
findings.actionableFix: Add a brief literature review or clarify that this is an isolated exploratory analysis with no external validation.

findings.title: Scatterplot figure not accessible for reviewer
findings.whyItMatters: The scatterplot is the only visual check of the raw relationship; its absence prevents assessment of outliers or non-linearity.
findings.actionableFix: Include the actual scatterplot image in the manuscript or ensure it is available during review.

missingEvidence: Raw data or analysis code for reproducibility
Diagnostic plots for partial correlation assumptions
Confidence interval for the partial correlation
